name: Hichisō (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hichisō town emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring with two curved horn-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hichisō, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 1969.

features.role: Hichisō town emblem — a stylised device of a ring with two curved horn-like strokes
